html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 of Vergrim's Amazing Self-Made Crown Relics from within the Vergrim's Vexation and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Vergrim's Vexation (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 1 of Vergrim's Amazing Self-Made Crown Relics from within the Vergrim's Vexation and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 of Vergrim's Amazing Self-Made Crown Relics. Looking for that perfect hood ornament for my brand new Gryphon. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Vergrim's Amazing Relic ×1

Client level range: 15–35
